proposals.title: Make one social offer report its actual committed result
proposals.behavior: Offer, permission, costs and learned result stay distinct; retain teacher provenance.
proposals.later_acceptance: Stale offer, denied permission, insufficient reputation/resources, failed grant, repeated choice; changed knowledge and save/reload.

proposals.title: Validate the complete durable save envelope
proposals.owner: src/save_files.js, src/save_compatibility.js and current native publisher
proposals.behavior: Keep metadata, world state and pending commands mutually compatible through recovery.
proposals.later_acceptance: Interrupted publication, malformed payload, unsupported version, missing cache and exact changed-positive save/reload/export/import.

proposals.title: Resume contextual guidance safely
proposals.owner: Existing onboarding/knowledge route; src/people_knowledge.js and docs/UI_RULES.md for UI routing
proposals.behavior: Save stable lesson/substep IDs, derive transient highlights from current location and known facts.
proposals.later_acceptance: Reload mid-lesson, missing/renamed lesson, absent target and close/reopen help; fresh rebuilt 1366×768 browser with populated save.

proposals.title: Keep NPC observation, eligibility and action result separate
proposals.behavior: Use one existing encounter; change ally presence or exact fitted tool to produce a useful alternate action.
proposals.later_acceptance: Observed/unobserved target, unavailable actual tool, area veto, direct alternative, exhausted methods; distinguish rejection from paid attempt.

proposals.title: Give generated lore a stable factual source
proposals.owner: Existing world/history, src/world_knowledge.js and quest owners
proposals.behavior: Journal, rumor and relic description refer to the same event identities with actor-specific discovery.
proposals.later_acceptance: Two discovered records agree on shared facts, unknown fact stays private, changed branch and save/reload retain provenance.

proposals.title: Declare each delayed effect’s clock and inactive-zone rule
proposals.owner: src/simulation_clock.js and current played-time/world scheduler owners
proposals.behavior: Use existing scheduling; distinguish game actions, played time, history and optional inactive-region catch-up.
proposals.later_acceptance: Pause/reload, exact due-time boundary, fast/slow actor policy, inactive region return and no duplicate settlement.

qualifications: No numeric Steam build comparison possible
All twelve aspects accounted for; bounded source reading only
DLC file presence does not prove load or entitlement
Inventory is complete by discovered namespace/table, not every method or consumer
